scenes.caption: A favourite.
scenes.say: Nadia has a favourite story. She wants to share it.

scenes.caption: A swap.
scenes.say: She swaps books with a classmate.

scenes.caption: A first reason.
scenes.say: Reason one: the plot has a surprising twist.

scenes.caption: A second reason.
scenes.say: Reason two: it reminds her of a trip with her grandmother.

scenes.caption: A pitch.
scenes.say: Nadia pitches the book in twenty seconds.

scenes.caption: A shelf.
scenes.say: The class puts books on a shared shelf.

scenes.caption: A new read.
scenes.say: Her classmate tries a genre she has never read.

scenes.caption: A reading community.
scenes.say: Together, they build a reading community.
